summary: security lens over ASKFLOOR-1-T6 (13 product path(s), 401a889..d681c84, Codex via the autoreview skill at --max-priority P2): 0 blocking, 2 non-blocking. The outage behavior is mostly fail-closed, but the inline allow fast path fails to clear a previously opened outage latch, suppressing a later required recovery-cycle notice. The principal invariance test also lacks an independent oracle and does not exercise several contractually required lane variants.

non_blocking_findings.summary: [P2] Clear the outage latch before returning an answered allow (apps/core/src/app/bootstrap/inline-agent-loop-tools.ts:422): When the inline classifier returns an `Answered` allow and the request has no explicit decision options, this return runs before `observeJudgeAvailabilityForRequest`.

[P2] Assert permission invariance against fixed expected tuples (apps/core/test/unit/runtime/askfloor-invariance.test.ts:86): The invariance test compares each unavailable result only with a result produced by the patched implementation itself.
